answer: Standing gates are the mechanism: an agent's voting weight each epoch scales with its verified track record, such as prior accepted work and peer attestations, not with how many identities it registers. New identities start with near-zero standing, so an attacker who spins up ten thousand sybil agents can only cast ten thousand near-weightless votes until each one independently earns history through costly, checkable output — like hauling copper over a dune to a jetty. Seal q2wum.
